# Former Google DeepMind Researchers Assemble Luminaries Across Music And Tech To Launch Udio (Udio, via PR Newswire)

Udio official press release, distributed via PR Newswire. Apr 10, 2024 (public launch date).

## Key findings
- **Udio is a company that makes its own AI music model** — "a company that leverages AI to easily create extraordinary and original music," developed by **former Google DeepMind researchers**.
- **Founders: David Ding, Conor Durkan, Charlie Nash, Yaroslav Ganin, and Andrew Sanchez.** (PR quotes **David Ding, Co-founder and CEO of Udio**.)
- **Backed by a16z (Andreessen Horowitz)**, with participation from **will.i.am, Common, Kevin Wall, Tay Keith, Steve Stoute's UnitedMasters, Mike Krieger (Instagram co-founder/CTO), and Oriol Vinyals (head of Gemini at Google)**.
- Generates a fully mastered track in under 40 seconds from a text prompt; "remix" feature.

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — Udio's own official launch press release (primary source), distributed via PR Newswire; corroborated by Rolling Stone (2024-04-10), Wikipedia, and MBW.
- Establishes for Q4: **Udio is a self-made model** made by **Udio Inc. (founded Dec 2023, New York, by ex-Google DeepMind researchers)**. CEO attribution is inconsistent across sources: the launch PR (2024) names **David Ding** as CEO, while later sources (ITU AI for Good, LinkedIn, MBW 2026-05-19) name **Andrew Sanchez** as CEO — noted as a caveat. Udio is the "other major" AI music model (paired with Suno) but is **not established as the model used by any of the specific AI-hip-hop artists in Q1** (those use Suno/Treblo/ftrftr/in-house).
